name: 3D Convex Splatting
definition: A method that moves beyond Gaussian primitives by introducing smooth convex shapes to represent scenes, aiming to offer greater flexibility and more accurate representation of flat surfaces and sharp edges with fewer primitives.
summary: 3D Convex Splatting is a neural rendering method using smooth convex polyhedra instead of Gaussians to accurately model flat surfaces and sharp edges with fewer primitives.
